what_this_is: Quantity-side design summary for reconciliation rows M and U (PREANALYSIS.md, 'The reconciliation rows'): how many panel units each buildable step treats, in which first years and by ownership class, and how the inventory places its sites. PROVISIONAL: the design stands as of 2026-11-18, the plan is a DRAFT and not frozen, and these counts move with the inventory. No price, revenue or outcome was read; counts are before any outcome-based sample rule (usable price, Short Form, three classes, the paper's 3-year rule) and before the treatment rules' own choices are settled, so each count names the choice it uses. The one exception is short_form_flags_for_row_u, which counts row U's quantity-side sample under the Short Form rule Joe adopted on 2026-11-20 (D-115), still with no price read.
written_by: pipeline/analysis/reconciliation_mu.py main(), written in session 19 and extended for row U in session 21, 2026-11-19 (the U0 assignment on the polygon incidence table and the Short Form flags' coverage), and in session 22 for Joe's ruling D-109 (U0 on the smallest containing polygon over every polygon, built; the four entity types listed; U0's identity with C0 to C2 computed; the missing-coverage qualification), and in session 25, 2026-11-20, for Joe's ruling D-115 (row U's quantity-side sample under the adopted Short Form rule, in short_form_flags_for_row_u), and in session 26, 2026-11-20, for Joe's ruling D-117 (row U's ownership classes from the panel's entity type read over 2001 to 2025, in row_u_ownership_classification_d117), and for his ruling D-119 of the same day (that type kept and described as the utility-level modal reported type carried across the panel, not the latest year-by-year EIA classification, with no further raw-data investigation)
rows_u_and_c_status: Comparison-only by Joe's ruling of 2026-11-19 (D-109). U0's assignment and C0 to C2's assignment are the same rule, the smallest containing polygon over every polygon of the layer with the type not read, applied to the same table. Their agreement site by site is one rule applied twice and is not independent validation of either. No assigned site is not proof of no facility. A unit with no site assigned to it under the polygon rule, or under the inventory's own assignment, is not shown to have no data center. A site outside every polygon, a site in an exact area tie, a site the inventory does not list, or a polygon whose utility is not a panel unit all leave a unit with no assigned site. Missing territory coverage is never evidence of no treatment.
ownership_classes_used_here: Row U: the panel's entity type of each utility-state, the utility-level modal reported type carried across the panel and not the latest year-by-year EIA classification (D-119), read as the last nonmissing value of the panel's column over 2001 to 2025 (D-117), one class for every year of the unit, mapped by reconciliation_mu.U_MAP, settled by Joe on 2026-11-20 (D-117), the type described as his ruling of the same day states (D-119); adopted_row_u_ownership_classes, row_u_ownership_classification_d117. Row M, dormant and outside D-117: the unit's last reported type by ownership_classes(q, 'M', 'last'), mapped by M_MAP, the agent's reading for this summary, not a ruling.

row_u_ownership_classification_d117.what_the_panel_column_is: The panel's entity_type column (data/interim/panel_quantities.parquet) is not a year-by-year report. pipeline/electricity/panel.py build(), read as code by the agent, computes it once per utility id as the type that id's own non-imputed filings report most often (value_counts().index[0] over the rows with a type), keeps only ids whose type is one of the six distribution entity types, and joins it to every row on utility_id_eia, so it is the same in every year of a utility-state and in every state of a utility; the panel's ownership column is that type mapped by panel.OWNERSHIP_GROUP. On this panel the last nonmissing type over 2001 to 2025 and the most frequent type are therefore the same for every utility-state by construction, and the years searched change no class. Joe ruled on 2026-11-20 (D-119) that rows U and C keep this type, in his words: "Keep the existing panel entity type for rows U and C, accurately described as the utility-level modal reported type carried across the panel, not the latest year-by-year EIA classification. No further raw-data investigation." The classes of rows U and C are therefore the utility-level modal reported type carried across the panel. Whether a year-by-year record of EIA's would differ for some utility was NOT established; it would need a read of the EIA-861 sales table under data/raw, which was not made, and under the same ruling no further raw-data investigation is made. Nothing here claims equivalence with EIA's year-by-year record.

U0|site_year_load.missing_coverage: No assigned site is not proof of no facility. A unit with no site assigned to it under the polygon rule, or under the inventory's own assignment, is not shown to have no data center. A site outside every polygon, a site in an exact area tie, a site the inventory does not list, or a polygon whose utility is not a panel unit all leave a unit with no assigned site. Missing territory coverage is never evidence of no treatment.
U0|site_year_load.assignment_rule: Our smallest-polygon approximation, not the paper's assignment. Each site goes to the smallest territory polygon that strictly contains it, over every polygon of the layer, the polygon's type not read (ours, a labelled approximation adopted by Joe on 2026-11-19, D-109). The paper gives priority to retail providers over wholesale-only territories (Ryu and Hiatt p. 5, Sec. 2.1). This layer's TYPE field does not establish which polygons are retail, so that priority is not applied, and exact reproduction of the paper's assignment is unavailable; the layer's vintage is also not the paper's. A site in two polygons of identical smallest area is listed with both and not placed (the tie is not broken), and a site in no polygon is listed and enters no utility. This is the same rule as row C's assignment at C0 to C2, so the two assignments agree by construction; that agreement is one rule applied twice and is not independent validation.

short_form_flags_for_row_u.status: The Short Form rule for row U was adopted by Joe on 2026-11-20 (D-115) and is applied below, on the quantity side, in sample_under_the_adopted_short_form_rule. Short Form exclusion as adopted by Joe on 2026-11-20 (D-115): a utility-state-year leaves where a record shows a Short Form filing, a row in the Short Form table that year or, for 2019, a flag of true in the operational file. Every other unit-year is kept with no record of a filing, which is no claim about whether it filed. The three-year count is taken after the exclusion. The 2019 exclusion is explicitly incomplete. The table has no 2019 rows, the exclusion that year rests on the operational file's flags, and a 2019 unit-year with a missing flag or with no flags row is kept with no record either way. A missing flag or an absent row does not establish non-filing. The sample is still not the paper's sample, and the row is comparison-only (D-109). Outcome availability (whether a unit-year has a price) is not used in place of the paper's Short Form exclusion (Joe, 2026-11-19, D-109). The records are the filer table (data/interim/reconciliation_short_form_filers.parquet, written once by the authorized read of 2026-11-20, D-113, and not regenerated) and the 2019 flags (data/interim/reconciliation_short_form_flags.parquet); the read under data/raw is not repeated. The flag in the flags file is True on some rows of 2019 and missing on every other row, and it is never False; under the adopted rule only a flag of true in 2019 is read as a record of a filing. Whether this flag is what the paper means by Short Form filers (endnote 10, p. 17) is not established.

step_u3_window_under_the_adopted_rule.what_this_is: Step U3's window is 2015 to 2025. The rule Joe adopted is stated for a utility-state-year, so for this step it is applied year by year over the step's own window (the session's reading, his to strike). Counted here on the quantity side, before the three-year count: the unit-years of the years past row U's own window, and how many of them a record shows as a filing. Where that count is zero, this reading and a reading with no exclusion in those years give the same flags.
